{"path": "chip8_openrouter-upstage-solar-pro4_01.html", "edit_description": "Rewrite the entire file as a clean, complete, self-contained CHIP-8 emulator. The file must be valid HTML with inline CSS and JavaScript (no external libraries, CDNs, assets, or backend). Requirements:

1. CHIP-8 interpreter with:
   - 4 KB memory (Uint8Array(4096)), font set loaded at 0x050, programs at 0x200
   - 16 8-bit registers V0–VF, VF is carry/borrow flag
   - 16-bit index register I, 16-bit program counter PC
   - Call stack (array, up to 16 levels), stack pointer
   - Delay timer and sound timer counting down at 60 Hz (decrement every frame if > 0)
   - 64×32 display buffer (Uint8Array(2048)), drawn on canvas (640×320, 10× scale)
   - Sprites drawn by XOR; VF set to 1 if any pixel flipped from 1 to 0 (collision)
   - 16-key keypad (Uint8Array(16)), key press/release both reach emulator

2. Complete 35-instruction instruction set, correctly decoded:
   - 00E0 CLS, 00EE RET
   - 1NNN JP addr, 2NNN CALL addr
   - 3XNN SE Vx, byte, 4XNN SNE Vx, byte
   - 5XY0 SE Vx, Vy
   - 6XNN LD Vx, byte, 7XNN ADD Vx, byte
   - 8XY0 LD Vx, Vy
   - 8XY1 OR Vx, Vy
   - 8XY2 AND Vx, Vy
   - 8XY3 XOR Vx, Vy
   - 8XY4 ADD Vx, Vy (VF = carry)
   - 8XY5 SUB Vx, Vy (VF = 1 if Vx > Vy, i.e., no borrow)
   - 8XY6 SHR Vx {, Vy} (store Vy in Vx first, then Vx = Vx >> 1, VF = LSB of original Vx)
   - 8XY7 SUBN Vx, Vy (VF = 1 if Vy > Vx)
   - 8XY8 SHL Vx {, Vy} (store Vy in Vx first, then Vx = Vx << 1, VF = MSB of original Vx)
   - 8XY9 SNE Vx, Vy
   - 9XY0 SNE Vx, Vy
   - ANNN LD I, addr
   - BNNN JP V0, addr (PC = addr + V0)
   - CXNN RND Vx, byte (Vx = random & byte)
   - DXYN DRW Vx, Vy, N (draw N-byte sprite at Vx, Vy; wrap coordinates mod 64/32; VF = collision)
   - EX9E SKP Vx (skip if key Vx is pressed), EXA1 SKNP Vx (skip if not pressed)
   - FX07 LD Vx, DT, FX0A LD Vx, K (wait for key, block until a key is pressed; store key index in Vx; do not advance PC while waiting), FX0B LD Vx, ST
   - FX15 LD DT, Vx, FX18 LD ST, Vx
   - FX1E ADD I, Vx (VF = 1 if I overflows 0xFFFF)
   - FX29 LD F, Vx (I = font character address = Vx * 5)
   - FX33 BCD Vx (store hundreds, tens, ones of Vx at I, I+1, I+2)
   - FX55 LD [I], Vx (store V0..Vx at I..I+x, I increments)
   - FX65 LD Vx, [I] (load V0..Vx from I..I+x, I increments)

   Note: FX01, FX02, FX03, FX04, FX05, FX06, FX08, FX09, FX0C, FX0D, FX0E, FX0F are NOT part of standard CHIP-8 — do NOT implement them. Only implement the real instructions listed above.

3. Correct shift semantics: 8XY6 and 8XYE must first copy Vy into Vx, THEN shift Vx and set VF from the original Vx value.

4. Display: canvas 640×320 (10× scale), pixelated rendering, black background, green pixels. Redraw only when display buffer changes (dirty flag).

5. Keypad: 4×4 grid of on-screen keys matching the physical keyboard mapping:
   Row 0: X, 1, 2, 3
   Row 1: Q, W, E, A
   Row 2: S, D, Z, C
   Row 3: 4, R, F, V
   Keydown/keyup events set the corresponding CHIP-8 key state (1/0) and update the visual pressed state.

6. Demo ROM: a real assembled program (byte array) embedded in the file that:
   - Clears the screen
   - Draws a sprite (use font data for character '0' at 0x050)
   - Waits for a key press (FX0A)
   - Moves the sprite right by 1 when key 1 is pressed, left by 1 when key 4 is pressed, down by 1 when key 3 is pressed, up by 1 when key 2 is pressed (use ADD/SUB with proper bounds or wrap)
   - Loops back to redraw
   The demo must actually run and be visible. Assemble the bytes yourself with correct addresses.

7. Controls (all working):
   - Run button: starts the emulation loop
   - Pause button: pauses it
   - Step button: executes exactly one instruction (pauses first)
   - Reset button: resets the emulator state and reloads the demo ROM
   - Load ROM button: file input that loads a .ch8/.rom binary file into memory at 0x200
   - Speed slider: 1–12 instructions per frame, displays current value

8. Debugger panel showing (updated every step):
   - 16 registers V0–VF as hex bytes (e.g., 0x0A)
   - Index register I as 4-digit hex
   - Program counter PC as 4-digit hex
   - Stack contents (up to 16 entries) as 4-digit hex addresses
   - Delay timer and sound timer values
   - Current instruction: opcode as 4-digit hex + decoded mnemonic text

9. UI: dark theme, readable layout, emulator section + debugger side by side (stack on mobile). Status indicator showing Running/Paused.

10. Main loop: requestAnimationFrame-based; when running, execute N instructions per frame (from slider), then update timers, then redraw display if dirty, then update debugger.

11. Every visible control must work. No console errors on load. The demo ROM must run when "Run" is clicked.

Write the complete file. Make sure the JavaScript is syntactically valid (no template literal issues, no undefined variables)."}
